purpose: Compare explicit-first source selection with bounded retrieval supplementation before any production Context Builder routing decision.
principles: Explicit task-linked sources remain first and are never displaced by supplementation.
Same-path source drift may be surfaced mechanically without repository-wide semantic inference.
The lexical candidate is a negative control, not a production proposal or revival of the legacy claim-card retriever.
Hard-negative abstention and forbidden temporal-source safety are non-tradeable gates.
Retrieval selects candidate sources only; evidence-card truth still belongs to the Stage 1 integrity scorer.
Future semantic/vector candidates must submit rankings to the same frozen evaluator and receive no automatic promotion.
